generatedSchema:
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id                                 String                            @id @default(uuid())
  phone                              String?                           @unique
  name                               String
  departmentId                       String?
  wxOpenid                           String?                           @unique
  passwordHash                       String?
  mustChangePassword                 Boolean                           @default(true)
  sessionVersion                     Int                               @default(0)
  temporaryPasswordExpiresAt         DateTime?
  recoveryCodeHash                   String?
  requiresChairmanManagement         Boolean                           @default(false)
  lastLoginAt                        DateTime?
  isActive                           Boolean                           @default(true)
  // 旧上传签名只用于历史单据预览与回退；新审批从不可变 Canvas 版本取快照。
  signatureFileId                    String?
  handwrittenSignatureVersions       HandwrittenSignatureVersion[]
  handwrittenSignatureHandoffs       HandwrittenSignatureHandoff[]
  businessEntrySubmissionSnapshots   BusinessEntrySubmissionSnapshot[]
  expenseClaimEntrySnapshots         ExpenseClaimEntrySnapshot[]
  fundExecutionEntrySnapshots        FundExecutionEntrySnapshot[]
  wageCreditorBreakdowns             WageCreditorBreakdown[]           @relation("WageCreditorUser")
  fundMovementsCreated               FundMovement[]                    @relation("FundMovementCreatedBy")
  fundMovementsSubmitted             FundMovement[]                    @relation("FundMovementSubmittedBy")
  fundMovementsConfirmed             FundMovement[]                    @relation("FundMovementConfirmedBy")
  fundMovementLegsCreated            FundMovementLeg[]                 @relation("FundMovementLegCreatedBy")
  fundMovementRelationshipsCreated   FundMovementRelationshipEntry[]   @relation("FundMovementRelationshipCreatedBy")
  fundMovementRelationshipsConfirmed FundMovementRelationshipEntry[]   @relation("FundMovementRelationshipConfirmedBy")
  createdAt                          DateTime                          @default(now())
  updatedAt                          DateTime                          @updatedAt
  employmentPeriods                  EmploymentPeriod[]
  personnelChanges                   PersonnelChange[]                 @relation("PersonnelChangeTarget")
  personnelChangesExecuted           PersonnelChange[]                 @relation("PersonnelChangeActor")

  @@index([departmentId])
}

// 一人多段任职。旧员工日期未经核实保持为空，不以账号创建时间补造。
model EmploymentPeriod {
  id              String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String
  startedOn       DateTime? @db.Date
  endedOn         DateTime? @db.Date
  endedAt         DateTime?
  verified        Boolean   @default(false)
  companyEntityId String?
  revision        Int       @default(1)
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())
  user            User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

// 办理事实兼作命令回执：同键同载荷重放结果，历史只追加。
model PersonnelChange {
  id                 String   @id @default(uuid())
  sequence           Int      @unique @default(autoincrement())
  commandKey         String   @unique
  payloadFingerprint String
  userId             String
  actorUserId        String
  action             String
  reason             String
  before             Json
  after              Json
  result             Json
  previousChangeId   String?
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())
  user               User     @relation("PersonnelChangeTarget", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  actor              User     @relation("PersonnelChangeActor", fields: [actorUserId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

// 未审核的入职申请不创建 User，不持有任何业务岗位。
model EmployeeRegistration {
  id                         String    @id @default(uuid())
  // 未批准申请仍独占手机号；已批准历史保留原号码，由迁移中的部分唯一索引约束。
  phone                      String
  name                       String
  passwordHash               String
  mustChangePassword         Boolean   @default(false)
  temporaryPasswordExpiresAt DateTime?
  status                     String    @default("pending")
  revision                   Int       @default(1)
  credentialVersion          Int       @default(0)
  phoneVerifiedAt            DateTime?
  departmentId               String?
  proposedRoles              Json      @default("[]")
  reason                     String    @default("")
  reviewedBy                 String?
  reviewedAt                 DateTime?
  userId                     String?   @unique
  createdAt                  DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt                  DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([status, createdAt])
}

model AuthRateLimit {
  key       String   @id
  hits      Int      @default(1)
  expiresAt DateTime

  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model SmsChallenge {
  id         String    @id @default(uuid())
  phone      String
  purpose    String
  binding    String
  codeHash   String
  attempts   Int       @default(0)
  delivered  Boolean   @default(false)
  consumedAt DateTime?
  expiresAt  DateTime
  createdAt  DateTime  @default(now())

  @@unique([phone, purpose])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

// Canvas 手写签名的不可变版本。新审批动作只允许绑定此表中的版本，旧上传图不回填。
model HandwrittenSignatureVersion {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId        String
  fileId        String   @unique
  contentSha256 String
  source        String   @default("canvas")
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

// 电脑端仅持有一次性链接；手机必须以同一账号完成签名，令牌本身不包含签名内容。
model HandwrittenSignatureHandoff {
  id                 String    @id @default(uuid())
  ownerUserId        String
  tokenHash          String    @unique
  expiresAt          DateTime
  invalidatedAt      DateTime?
  completedAt        DateTime?
  signatureVersionId String?
  createdAt          DateTime  @default(now())

  ownerUser User @relation(fields: [ownerUserId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@index([ownerUserId, expiresAt])
}

// 我方公司主体字典：合同签订时选择其一，名称快照进合同。
model RegisteredFundAccount {
  id                 String                            @id @default(uuid())
  writeRevision      Int                               @default(0)
  scopeKey           String                            @unique
  kind               String
  companyEntityId    String?                           @unique
  company            CompanyEntity?                    @relation(fields: [companyEntityId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  registeredPayments RegisteredPaymentFunding[]
  allocations        RegisteredFundPaymentAllocation[]
  registrations      FundAccountBalanceRegistration[]
  createdAt          DateTime                          @default(now())
}

model FundAccountBalanceRegistration {
  id                     String                     @id @default(uuid())
  accountId              String
  version                Int
  kind                   String
  status                 String
  previousRegistrationId String?
  approvalInstanceId     String?                    @unique
  balanceYuan            Decimal?                   @db.Decimal(24, 4)
  coveredExecutionIds    String[]                   @default([])
  asOfDate               String
  evidenceReference      String
  reconciliationNote     String
  reason                 String
  idempotencyKey         String                     @unique
  payloadFingerprint     String
  createdByUserId        String
  confirmedByUserId      String?
  confirmedAt            DateTime?
  reviewNote             String?
  closedByUserId         String?
  closedAt               DateTime?
  closeReason            String?
  createdAt              DateTime                   @default(now())
  account                RegisteredFundAccount      @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  payments               RegisteredPaymentFunding[]
  sources                FundAccountSourceBatch[]

  @@unique([accountId, version])
  @@unique([id, accountId])
  @@index([accountId, status])
}

model FundAccountSourceBatch {
  id                    String                            @id @default(uuid())
  registrationId        String
  lineNo                Int
  amountYuan            Decimal                           @db.Decimal(24, 4)
  sourceStatus          String
  sourceName            String?
  projectStatus         String
  projectId             String?
  previousSourceBatchId String?
  allocations           RegisteredFundPaymentAllocation[]
  registration          FundAccountBalanceRegistration    @relation(fields: [registrationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@unique([registrationId, lineNo])
}

model CompanyEntity {
  registeredFundAccount               RegisteredFundAccount?
  id                                  String                          @id @default(uuid())
  name                                String
  unifiedSocialCreditCode             String?
  registeredAddress                   String?
  dataStatus                          String                          @default("legacy_incomplete")
  currentVersionNo                    Int                             @default(0)
  isActive                            Boolean                         @default(true)
  fundMovementsAsSource               FundMovement[]                  @relation("FundMovementSourceCompany")
  fundMovementsAsBeneficiary          FundMovement[]                  @relation("FundMovementBeneficiaryCompany")
  fundMovementLegs                    FundMovementLeg[]               @relation("FundMovementLegCompany")
  fundMovementRelationshipsAsDebtor   FundMovementRelationshipEntry[] @relation("FundMovementRelationshipDebtorCompany")
  fundMovementRelationshipsAsCreditor FundMovementRelationshipEntry[] @relation("FundMovementRelationshipCreditorCompany")
  createdAt                           DateTime                        @default(now())
  updatedAt                           DateTime                        @updatedAt
}

// Server-issued bank-account legal-holder authority.  This is intentionally
// not a user-maintained bank-account directory: payment execution accepts
// only the opaque reference issued by the verification authority and freezes
// the verified holder facts below.
model PaymentExecutionPayerVerification {
  id                                String   @id @default(uuid())
  reference                         String   @unique
  holderCompanyEntityId             String
  holderNameSnapshot                String
  holderCreditCodeSnapshot          String
  verificationReference             String
  verifiedByUserId                  String
  verifiedAt                        DateTime
  verificationEvidenceFileId        String
  verificationEvidenceContentSha256 String
  status                            String   @default("verified")
  sourceType                        String   @default("bank_account_legal_holder")
  sourceRecordId                    String
  issuedByDatabaseRole              String   @default("jg_payment_execution_payer_issuer")
  createdAt                         DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([sourceType, sourceRecordId])
  @@index([holderCompanyEntityId, status])
  @@index([verificationEvidenceFileId])
  @@index([verifiedByUserId])
}

model CompanyEntityVersion {
  id                      String   @id @default(uuid())
  companyEntityId         String
  versionNo               Int
  name                    String
  unifiedSocialCreditCode String?
  registeredAddress       String?
  isActive                Boolean
  action                  String
  actorUserId             String?
  actorRoleKey            String?
  createdAt               DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([companyEntityId, versionNo])
  @@index([name])
  @@index([unifiedSocialCreditCode])
}

model RefreshToken {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  tokenHash String    @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  revokedAt DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
}

// 所有新业务正式编号按前缀和北京时间自然日独立递增；编号允许断号且不回收。
model BusinessDailySequence {
  prefix       String
  businessDate String
  nextSequence Int
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@id([prefix, businessDate])
}

model Department {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String   @unique
  parentId  String?
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([parentId])
}

model Position {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  key       String   @unique
  name      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model UserPosition {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId     String
  positionId String
  projectId  String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([userId, positionId, projectId])
}

model Project {
  id                                     String                            @id @default(uuid())
  code                                   String                            @unique
  name                                   String
  operatingLedgerEffectiveDate           DateTime?                         @db.Date
  takeoverCompletedDate                  DateTime?                         @db.Date
  takeoverStatus                         String                            @default("preparing")
  constructionEnterpriseLockedAt         DateTime?
  businessEntrySubmissionSnapshots       BusinessEntrySubmissionSnapshot[]
  fundMovementsAsSource                  FundMovement[]                    @relation("FundMovementSourceProject")
  fundMovementsAsBeneficiary             FundMovement[]                    @relation("FundMovementBeneficiaryProject")
  fundMovementLegs                       FundMovementLeg[]                 @relation("FundMovementLegProject")
  fundMovementRelationshipsAsSource      FundMovementRelationshipEntry[]   @relation("FundMovementRelationshipSourceProject")
  fundMovementRelationshipsAsBeneficiary FundMovementRelationshipEntry[]   @relation("FundMovementRelationshipBeneficiaryProject")
  necessaryExpenseReserves               ProjectNecessaryExpenseReserve[]
  projectFundDisputes                    ProjectFundDispute[]
  closeAggregate                         ProjectCloseAggregate?
  isActive                               Boolean                           @default(true)
  createdAt                              DateTime                          @default(now())
  updatedAt                              DateTime                          @updatedAt
}

// 项目挂靠企业只通过显式映射生效；变更时结束旧行并新增快照，不覆盖历史事实。
model ProjectAffiliateAssignment {
  id                          String                           @id @default(uuid())
  projectId                   String
  businessPartyId             String
  businessPartyVersionId      String
  affiliateNameSnapshot       String
  affiliateCreditCodeSnapshot String?
  effectiveFrom               DateTime
  endedAt                     DateTime?
  changeReason                String
  assignedByUserId            String
  endedByUserId               String?
  createdAt                   DateTime                         @default(now())
  updatedAt                   DateTime                         @updatedAt
  necessaryExpenseReserves    ProjectNecessaryExpenseReserve[]
  projectFundDisputes         ProjectFundDispute[]

  @@index([projectId, effectiveFrom])
  @@index([businessPartyId])
  @@index([businessPartyVersionId])
}

// 项目参与公司按生效期间追加；已有正式事实的历史行不得覆盖。
model ProjectParticipatingCompany {
  id                        String    @id @default(uuid())
  projectId                 String
  companyEntityId           String
  companyEntityVersionId    String
  companyNameSnapshot       String
  companyCreditCodeSnapshot String?
  effectiveFrom             DateTime  @db.Date
  endedAt                   DateTime? @db.Date
  changeReason              String
  addedByUserId             String
  endedByUserId             String?
  createdAt                 DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt                 DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([projectId, effectiveFrom])
  @@index([companyEntityId])
  @@index([companyEntityVersionId])
}

// 纯技术并发栅栏；仅用于串行化同一项目下不同参与关系的删除/停止。
// 故意不建 Project 外键，避免首次删除通过外键检查反向锁定 Project。
model ProjectParticipatingCompanyMutationFence {
  projectId String @id
  revision  BigInt @default(0)
}

// POL-16 project close root. This row is the sole lock coordinate; business
// history remains append-only in the version and receipt tables below.
model ProjectCloseAggregate {
  projectId String   @id
  revision  Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  project                Project                                  @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseAggregate_project_fkey")
  stageVersions          ProjectCloseStageVersion[]
  receipts               ProjectCloseCommandReceipt[]
  attestations           ProjectCloseProfessionalAttestation[]
  profitConfirmations    ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation[]
  distributions          ProjectCloseDistribution[]
  profitAuthorizations   ProjectProfitDistributionAuthorization[]
  temporaryDistributions ProjectTemporaryProfitDistribution[]
  impacts                ProjectCloseImpact[]
  decisionSubmissions    ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission[]
}

model ProjectCloseStageVersion {
  id                          String   @id @default(uuid())
  projectId                   String
  stageKey                    String
  revision                    Int
  status                      String
  previousVersionId           String?
  prerequisiteStageVersionIds Json     @default("[]")
  projectionReadAt            DateTime
  projectionCutoffAt          DateTime
  projectionFingerprint       String
  amountSnapshot              Json
  stateSnapshot               Json
  basisSnapshot               Json
  confirmedByUserId           String
  confirmedAt                 DateTime
  idempotencyKey              String   @unique
  payloadFingerprint          String
  createdAt                   DateTime @default(now())

  aggregate                        ProjectCloseAggregate              @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [projectId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseStageVersion_aggregate_fkey")
  previousVersion                  ProjectCloseStageVersion?          @relation("ProjectCloseStageVersionHistory", fields: [projectId, previousVersionId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseStageVersion_previous_project_fkey")
  nextVersions                     ProjectCloseStageVersion[]         @relation("ProjectCloseStageVersionHistory")
  receipts                         ProjectCloseCommandReceipt[]
  attestationLinks                 ProjectCloseStageAttestationLink[]
  profitConfirmation               ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation?
  distribution                     ProjectCloseDistribution?
  decisionSubmissionsAsProfitStage ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission[]   @relation("ProjectCloseDecisionSubmissionProfitStageBasis")

  @@unique([projectId, stageKey, revision], map: "ProjectCloseStageVersion_project_stage_revision_key")
  @@unique([projectId, id], map: "ProjectCloseStageVersion_project_id_key")
  @@index([projectId, stageKey, createdAt], map: "ProjectCloseStageVersion_project_stage_created_idx")
  @@index([previousVersionId], map: "ProjectCloseStageVersion_previous_idx")
}

model ProjectCloseImpact {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  projectId             String
  sourceType            String
  sourceId              String
  sourceFingerprint     String
  reason                String
  affectedStages        Json
  observedAt            DateTime
  projectionFingerprint String
  idempotencyKey        String   @unique
  payloadFingerprint    String
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())

  aggregate ProjectCloseAggregate @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [projectId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseImpact_aggregate_fkey")

  @@unique([projectId, sourceType, sourceId, sourceFingerprint], map: "ProjectCloseImpact_source_fingerprint_key")
  @@index([projectId, observedAt], map: "ProjectCloseImpact_project_observed_idx")
}

model ProjectTemporaryProfitDistribution {
  id                              String   @id @default(uuid())
  projectId                       String
  revision                        Int
  projectParticipatingCompanyId   String
  companyEntityId                 String
  companyEntityVersionId          String
  companyNameSnapshot             String
  companyCreditCodeSnapshot       String?
  amountCents                     BigInt
  authorizationCeilingCents       BigInt
  temporaryDistributedBeforeCents BigInt
  authorizedCumulativeCents       BigInt
  projectionReadAt                DateTime
  projectionCutoffAt              DateTime
  projectionFingerprint           String
  basisSnapshot                   Json
  authorizedByUserId              String
  authorizedAt                    DateTime
  idempotencyKey                  String   @unique
  payloadFingerprint              String
  createdAt                       DateTime @default(now())

  aggregate     ProjectCloseAggregate                   @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [projectId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectTemporaryProfitDistribution_aggregate_fkey")
  authorization ProjectProfitDistributionAuthorization?

  @@unique([projectId, revision], map: "ProjectTemporaryProfitDistribution_project_revision_key")
  @@index([projectId, companyEntityId, createdAt], map: "ProjectTemporaryProfitDistribution_project_company_idx")
}

model ProjectCloseProfessionalAttestation {
  id                    String   @id @default(uuid())
  projectId             String
  specialty             String
  revision              Int
  projectionReadAt      DateTime
  projectionCutoffAt    DateTime
  projectionFingerprint String
  basisSnapshot         Json
  attestedByUserId      String
  attestedAt            DateTime
  idempotencyKey        String   @unique
  payloadFingerprint    String
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())

  aggregate ProjectCloseAggregate             @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [projectId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseProfessionalAttestation_aggregate_fkey")
  stageLink ProjectCloseStageAttestationLink?

  @@unique([projectId, specialty, revision], map: "ProjectCloseAttestation_project_specialty_revision_key")
  @@index([projectId, specialty, createdAt], map: "ProjectCloseAttestation_project_specialty_created_idx")
}

model ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission {
  id                          String   @id @default(uuid())
  projectId                   String
  decisionKind                String
  revision                    Int
  previousSubmissionId        String?
  prerequisiteStageVersionIds Json     @default("[]")
  profitConfirmationId        String?
  profitStageVersionId        String?
  projectionReadAt            DateTime
  projectionCutoffAt          DateTime
  projectionFingerprint       String
  amountSnapshot              Json
  stateSnapshot               Json
  participantsSnapshot        Json
  proposalSnapshot            Json
  basisSnapshot               Json
  preparedByUserId            String
  preparedAt                  DateTime
  submittedByUserId           String
  submittedAt                 DateTime
  idempotencyKey              String   @unique
  payloadFingerprint          String
  createdAt                   DateTime @default(now())

  aggregate               ProjectCloseAggregate            @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [projectId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission_aggregate_fkey")
  previousSubmission      ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission?  @relation("ProjectCloseDecisionSubmissionHistory", fields: [projectId, previousSubmissionId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission_previous_project_fkey")
  nextSubmissions         ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission[] @relation("ProjectCloseDecisionSubmissionHistory")
  profitConfirmationBasis ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation?  @relation("ProjectCloseDecisionSubmissionProfitBasis", fields: [projectId, profitConfirmationId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission_profit_project_fkey")
  profitStageVersionBasis ProjectCloseStageVersion?        @relation("ProjectCloseDecisionSubmissionProfitStageBasis", fields: [projectId, profitStageVersionId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission_profit_stage_project_fkey")
  profitConfirmation      ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation?
  distribution            ProjectCloseDistribution?

  @@unique([projectId, decisionKind, revision], map: "ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission_project_kind_revision_key")
  @@unique([projectId, id], map: "ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission_project_id_key")
  @@index([previousSubmissionId], map: "ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission_previous_idx")
  @@index([profitConfirmationId], map: "ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission_profit_idx")
  @@index([profitStageVersionId], map: "ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission_profit_stage_idx")
}

model ProjectCloseStageAttestationLink {
  stageVersionId String
  attestationId  String @unique
  specialty      String

  stageVersion ProjectCloseStageVersion            @relation(fields: [stageVersionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseStageAttestationLink_stage_fkey")
  attestation  ProjectCloseProfessionalAttestation @relation(fields: [attestationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseStageAttestationLink_attestation_fkey")

  @@id([stageVersionId, specialty])
}

model ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation {
  id                     String   @id @default(uuid())
  projectId              String
  stageVersionId         String   @unique
  submissionId           String   @unique
  revision               Int
  previousConfirmationId String?
  finalProfitCents       BigInt
  projectionReadAt       DateTime
  projectionCutoffAt     DateTime
  projectionFingerprint  String
  formulaVersion         String
  amountSnapshot         Json
  sourceSnapshot         Json
  basisSnapshot          Json
  confirmedByUserId      String
  confirmedAt            DateTime
  idempotencyKey         String   @unique
  payloadFingerprint     String
  createdAt              DateTime @default(now())

  aggregate               ProjectCloseAggregate            @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [projectId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation_aggregate_fkey")
  stageVersion            ProjectCloseStageVersion         @relation(fields: [projectId, stageVersionId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation_stage_project_fkey")
  submission              ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission   @relation(fields: [projectId, submissionId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation_submission_project_fkey")
  previousConfirmation    ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation?  @relation("ProjectCloseProfitConfirmationHistory", fields: [projectId, previousConfirmationId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation_previous_project_fkey")
  nextConfirmations       ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation[] @relation("ProjectCloseProfitConfirmationHistory")
  distributionSubmissions ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission[] @relation("ProjectCloseDecisionSubmissionProfitBasis")
  distributions           ProjectCloseDistribution[]

  @@unique([projectId, revision], map: "ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation_project_revision_key")
  @@unique([projectId, id], map: "ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation_project_id_key")
  @@unique([projectId, stageVersionId], map: "ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation_project_stage_key")
  @@unique([projectId, submissionId], map: "ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation_project_submission_key")
  @@index([previousConfirmationId], map: "ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation_previous_idx")
}

model ProjectCloseDistribution {
  id                     String   @id @default(uuid())
  projectId              String
  stageVersionId         String   @unique
  submissionId           String   @unique
  profitConfirmationId   String
  revision               Int
  previousDistributionId String?
  totalProfitCents       BigInt
  projectionReadAt       DateTime
  projectionCutoffAt     DateTime
  projectionFingerprint  String
  basisSnapshot          Json
  confirmedByUserId      String
  confirmedAt            DateTime
  idempotencyKey         String   @unique
  payloadFingerprint     String
  createdAt              DateTime @default(now())

  aggregate            ProjectCloseAggregate                    @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [projectId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseDistribution_aggregate_fkey")
  stageVersion         ProjectCloseStageVersion                 @relation(fields: [projectId, stageVersionId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseDistribution_stage_project_fkey")
  submission           ProjectCloseDecisionSubmission           @relation(fields: [projectId, submissionId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseDistribution_submission_project_fkey")
  profitConfirmation   ProjectCloseProfitConfirmation           @relation(fields: [projectId, profitConfirmationId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseDistribution_profit_project_fkey")
  previousDistribution ProjectCloseDistribution?                @relation("ProjectCloseDistributionHistory", fields: [projectId, previousDistributionId], references: [projectId, id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "ProjectCloseDistribution_previous_project_fkey")
  nextDistributions    ProjectCloseDistribution[]               @relation("ProjectCloseDistributionHistory")
  lines                ProjectCloseDistributionLine[]
  authorizations       ProjectProfitDistributionAuthorization[]

  @@unique([projectId, revision], map: "ProjectCloseDistribution_project_revision_key")

  projectionOrigin            String    @default("ordinary")
  sourceVersionId             String
  sourceSnapshot              Json
  // 仅保存工资经营 envelope 的非敏感冻结坐标；人员、金额、债权人和证据仍只留在

  createdByUserId             String
  lastEditedByUserId          String
  submittedByUserId           String?
  submittedAt                 DateTime?
  confirmedByUserId           String?
  confirmedAt                 DateTime?
  reviewReturnedByUserId      String?
  reviewReturnedAt            DateTime?

  supersededAt                DateTime?

  @@index([adjustsPayableRefId])

// POL-13A intentionally references an existing PaymentExecution instead of
// creating another bank-payment fact. Each confirmed allocation stores the
// exact source snapshot it consumed so later upstream corrections can derive
// the effective balance without rewriting payment history.
model PayableSettlementCase {
  id                 String    @id @default(uuid())
  paymentExecutionId String
  status             String    @default("draft")

  updatedAt          DateTime  @updatedAt

  revisions                      PayableSettlementCase[]           @relation("PayableSettlementCaseRevision")

  @@unique([paymentExecutionId, revision], map: "PayableSettlementCase_execution_revision_key")
  @@index([status, updatedAt])
  @@index([supersedesCaseId])
}

  creditorCompanyId                     String

  creditorSnapshot                      Json
  approvedPayerSnapshot                 Json
  amountCents                           BigInt
  currencyCode                          String    @default("CNY")
  evidenceFileId                        String?
  evidenceClaimId                       String?
  evidenceUploadedByUserId              String?
  evidenceContentSha256                 String?
  authorizationEvidenceFileId           String?
  authorizationEvidenceContentSha256    String?
  reauthorizationReference              String?
  reauthorizedByUserId                  String?
  reauthorizedAt                        DateTime?
  actualPayerVerificationEvidenceFileId String?
  actualPayerVerificationContentSha256  String?
  projectId                             String?

  contractVersionId                     String?
  sourceType                            String?
  sourceAggregateId                     String?
  sourceAllocationCount                 Int?

  reason                                String?
  idempotencyKey                        String    @unique
  payloadFingerprint                    String

  confirmedByUserId                     String?
  createdAt                             DateTime  @default(now())

  settlementCase   PayableSettlementCase?                 @relation(fields: [settlementCaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  originalEntry    InterEntityRelationshipEntry?          @relation("InterEntityRelationshipAdjustments", fields: [adjustsEntryId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  adjustments      InterEntityRelationshipEntry[]         @relation("InterEntityRelationshipAdjustments")
  evidenceClaims   InterEntityRelationshipEvidenceClaim[] @relation("InterEntityRelationshipEvidenceClaims")

  @@unique([settlementCaseId, entryKind], map: "InterEntityRelationshipEntry_case_kind_key")
  @@index([adjustsEntryId])
  @@index([originalDebtorCompanyId, creditorCompanyId, createdAt])
  @@index([paymentExecutionId])
  @@index([settlementCaseId])
  @@index([fundExecutionId, fundExecutionCaseId])
  @@index([executionAllocationLineId])

}

model SpotPaymentAuditSource {
  id            String   @id
  code          String
  projectId     String
  procurementId String
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
}

// One canonical PaymentExecution; this immutable receipt freezes only funding
// attribution and the actor's opening-inclusion declaration, never another payment.
model RegisteredPaymentFunding {
  executionId                                String                            @id
  operatingLedgerEffectiveDateAtRegistration DateTime?                         @db.Date
  actualPayerKind                            String
  actualPayerId                              String
  actualPayerSnapshot                        Json
  accountId                                  String
  balanceRegistrationId                      String
  openingTreatment                           String
  openingReason                              String
  openingEvidence                            String
  contractHistoryConfirmation                Json?
  payloadFingerprint                         String
  execution                                  PaymentExecution                  @relation(fields: [executionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  account                                    RegisteredFundAccount             @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  registration                               FundAccountBalanceRegistration    @relation(fields: [balanceRegistrationId, accountId], references: [id, accountId], onDelete: Restrict)
  allocations                                RegisteredFundPaymentAllocation[]

  @@unique([executionId, accountId])
}

model RegisteredFundPaymentAllocation {
  id            String                   @id @default(uuid())
  executionId   String
  accountId     String
  sourceBatchId String
  amountCents   BigInt
  funding       RegisteredPaymentFunding @relation(fields: [executionId, accountId], references: [executionId, accountId], onDelete: Restrict)
  account       RegisteredFundAccount    @relation(fields: [accountId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  source        FundAccountSourceBatch   @relation(fields: [sourceBatchId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@unique([executionId, sourceBatchId])
  @@index([accountId, sourceBatchId])
}

// Durable payment source event, committed with the fact and allocations.
// This is not the approval notification outbox or a delivery receipt.
model RegisteredPaymentEvent {
  executionId String           @id
  eventType   String           @default("payment_execution.registered")
  payload     Json
  createdAt   DateTime         @default(now())
  execution   PaymentExecution @relation(fields: [executionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
}

// A later private voucher is evidence for the same immutable payment fact.
model RegisteredPaymentVoucher {
  executionId      String           @id
  fileId           String           @unique
  file             FileObject       @relation(fields: [fileId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict, onUpdate: Restrict)
  uploadedByUserId String
  contentSha256    String
  createdAt        DateTime         @default(now())
  execution        PaymentExecution @relation(fields: [executionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
}

// Technical serialization coordinate only; never a payment or balance fact.
model RegisteredContractHistoryRevision {
  contractId String   @id
  revision   BigInt   @default(0)
  contract   Contract @relation(fields: [contractId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)
}
